integrity: Exact analytical derivations; included standalone symbolic and finite numerical checker; computations do not independently certify the global or asymptotic conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Only a three-oscillator equal-coupling two-Fourier-harmonic phase surrogate is analyzed. The result is about periodic relative phases, not delay-differential neuron dynamics; the global portrait outside the stated parameter interval is not determined, and historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp third-harmonic rigidity and a cubic-root collision clock in a three-phase network
